description: Word problems, simple deduction and pattern items. Re-uses the deterministic graders: numeric answers via SymPy (math_numeric), short text answers via normalized exact match.

items.prompt: Tom has 3 apples. He then buys 2 bags that each contain 4 apples. How many apples does he have now?
A train travels 60 miles in 1.5 hours. What is its average speed in miles per hour?
Sarah is twice as old as Tom. Tom is 7 years old. How old is Sarah?
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 4, 8, 16, ...?
A shirt costs $20 and is discounted by 25%. What is the sale price in dollars?
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be in 3 days? Give the day name.
All cats are mammals. Is a cat a mammal? Answer yes or no.
All bloops are razzies, and all razzies are lazzies. Are all bloops lazzies? Answer yes or no.
A box contains 3 red balls and 2 blue balls. How many balls are in the box in total?
Which is larger, 3/4 or 2/3? Answer with the larger fraction.
John is taller than Mary, and Mary is taller than Sue. Who is the shortest of the three?
How many sides does a hexagon have?
